entry_points.text: Guest-mode work entry checks flags with interrupts enabled and drains work until clear; pidfd entry wakes waiters for already exiting tasks.
In-kernel wait validates option mask and identifier selection; namespace teardown blocks allocation, enables autoreap, kills survivors and waits for baseline counts.
Termination entry coordinates group exit and dump rendezvous, ordered teardown, zombie notification and scheduler handoff; last thread of global init panics.

exports.text: Published helpers supply pid lookup with reference plus detach and free, signal queue flush, parent and pidfd notification with waiter wake, orphaned-group query, group broadcast, credential namespace exit and sighand cleanup.
Execution state service offers allocation, reference release and dumpability query for per-task objects.
Ownership maintenance and exit-time address release provide single-shot virtual-fork rendezvous plus userspace identifier clearing with wakeup while sharing persists.
Shared wait scanning engine parks callers and translates absence to retry or no-child, plus resource usage query for thread self children or combined scopes.

hazards.text: Handler clearing needs release visibility for lockless readers; staged pid array must reject duplicates; thread pid must be pinned before unhash to avoid early free.
Null owner despite sharing indicates racing holders; zombie reaping needs atomic election with stable reads; namespace shutdown depends on blocked allocation plus autoreap for global absence.
Status copy and resource capture may fault after dropping protection, requiring held references and revalidation; tracer teardown can terminate tracees; init exit panics with group code.

invariants.text: Exec-state starts counted once and non-dumpable; copy allocates a fresh object sharing the namespace and snapshotting dumpability with RCU publish, final drop defers reclaim via RCU.

Unhash drops global and per-cpu counts, detaches pids and links and wakes waiters; signal exit handles timers and group paths, folds times faults switches and IO, then clears handler with release ordering.

Orphan check skips ignored exiting empty and reparented members; orphaned groups with stopped jobs get hangup then continue; kill permission allows kernel origin else audits credentials and capability before security hook.

Owner reassignment scans the group and revalidates mapping under task lock before publish and migration; reaper prefers configured reaper or live thread; eligibility partitions clone versus standard children; reaping folds leader and shared measures.

Traced wait scans the traced list for the first considerable task; identified wait tries the group identifier untraced then the traced thread; reaper prefers live thread then nearest subreaper else fallback.

Unused stack is estimated from zeroed canary scan with growth-dependent direction; accounting tracks pages or node counters with memcg drop; kthread exit records result and clears affinity under mutex.

Task exit clears local and remote coverage, resets mode area and sequence, prunes matching remote maps and frees on last reference; filter release detaches then walks predecessors to wake waiters and destroy unreferenced programs.
These behaviors rely on opaque external helpers for RCU locking refcounts task and namespace queries and scheduling annotations, cited only and not specified here.

locks.text: Exec-state reads use RCU with locked exchange for replace; pid pointer choice and mutation need task-list exclusion and stage old pid only when unreferenced.
Address detach masks interrupts around null publication; reaper promotion, ptrace unlink, child-disposition check and filter detach serialize under task-list or sighand exclusion.
Pid allocation disable clears adding mark under pid-map lock; namespace proxy swap gains a reference, exchanges under task lock in sleepable context, then releases old proxy.

state_machines.text: Release pins pid, unhashes under exclusion, flushes proc entry, exits namespaces, mixes runtime, frees staged pids and drops references; dump participants rendezvous then idle until finished.
Zombie path requires exited interest and elects one reaper by atomic move with peek and traced handoff; stopped and continued paths select codes and consume markers unless peeking.
Exiting tasks reparent children, become zombie, notify the right parent or autoreap with exec waiter wake; tracer exit terminates marked tracees, detaches all and finalizes empty zombie groups.
Signal exit marks exiting under change guard, drains private pending to local list, retargets shared signals, completes group stop and notifies leader parent after unlock.

structs.text: Exec-state cache holds aligned accountable objects with count dumpability and namespace link; release staging holds one pid pointer per type for deferred free.
Personality call returns prior value unless all-bits-set sentinel; execdomains entry shows one fixed Linux line; oops limit sysctl defaults to ten thousand with decimal count via sysfs.
Wait request aggregates selectors flags info and resource pointers with sticky absence code; observed task signal and coverage state expose exit linkage counters reaper and sequence fields.
Stack use is binned into a histogram with low-water mark; signal wait pid-type exit-state and job-control numeric encodings stay externally defined.
